content:
The Women's team archery event at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London was held at Lord's Cricket Ground from July 27-29, 2012.

## Competition Format
- Teams consisted of 3 archers per country
- The competition used a recurve bow at 70 meters distance
- Format included a ranking round followed by head-to-head elimination matches
- Each match consisted of 4 ends of 6 arrows (2 per archer), for a maximum score of 240 points

## Medal Results

**Gold Medal: South Korea** 🥇
- Team: Ki Bo-bae, Lee Sung-jin, Choi Hyeon-ju
- Defeated China 210-209 in a dramatic final
- This was South Korea's 7th consecutive Olympic gold in women's team archery (since 1988)

**Silver Medal: China** 🥈
- Team: Cheng Ming, Fang Yuting, Xu Jing

**Bronze Medal: Japan** 🥉
- Team: Miki Kanie, Ren Hayakawa, Kaori Kawanaka
- Defeated Russia 209-207 in the bronze medal match
- This was Japan's first Olympic medal in women's team archery

## Notable Highlights
- South Korea's victory maintained their perfect Olympic record in this event - they have never lost the women's team event since it was introduced in 1988
- The gold medal match was extremely close, decided by just one point
- 12 teams qualified for the team event based on their performance in the individual ranking round

The event showcased the continued dominance of Asian nations in Olympic archery, with all three medals going to teams from Asia.
